correctness.rationale: The proof establishes a rank-two pair of spectral sink columns for each nonprincipal eigenspace using connected distance graphs and impossibility of rank-one nonprincipal eigenspaces; the Gram sum yields 2d+1 and the exact site law. The loss semigroup has no nondecaying mode outside the dark eigenspace, so asymptotic capture is bright projector weight. Exact rational spectral checks on two graphs and exhaustive pair testing on five graphs are consistent but not substitutes for proof.

value.rationale: The exact capturing dimension is a natural global quantum transport invariant for every absorber placement and arbitrary graph diameter, with a closed computable local law. It unifies but strictly extends known separate strongly-regular and Hamming subclasses; its primitivity condition sharply identifies a structural boundary and is not an arbitrary narrow calculation.
